{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for commas in the revenue column across the entire dataset
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

print(f"Number of rows with commas in 'revenue': {has_commas.sum()}")
print(f"Rows with commas (first 5):\n{df[has_commas]['revenue'].head(5).values}")"}
